name: video-edit-halal
description: Arabic video editing for Claude Code — 5 skills: talking-head reels, 3D motion explainers, podcasts, beat-synced montage, covers & thumbnails, plus tools for the halal background-audio library (files in the halal-audio plugin). Based on video-edit 6.0.1. DaVinci Resolve is a separate add-on (majed-davinci).
